acquisition_method.evidence: inferred: For each cycle, twenty most abundant precursor ions with charge state ≥ 2 were sequentially isolated.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Briefly, equal amounts of protein from each cell line was reduced using tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine (TCEP) at 60 °C for 1 h and alkylated using methyl methanethiosulfonate (MMTS) for 20 min at room temperature.

cleavage_agent.evidence: The samples were then digested using trypsin (Promega, San Luis Obispo, CA) overnight at 37 °C.

collision_energy.evidence: Higher energy collision dissociation was used as the activation method with 40% normalized collision energy.

fractionation_method.evidence: The iTRAQ-labeled samples were pooled, dried and subjected to SCX fractionation, as described earlier.

fragmentation_method.evidence: Higher energy collision dissociation was used as the activation method with 40% normalized collision energy.
